card-security-code-input.name: Card Security Code Input
card-security-code-input.purpose: Capture one card security code with numeric keyboard, cc-csc autocomplete, local length validation, optional reveal, helper/error copy, and Design System field states.
card-security-code-input.referenceRationale: The reference ZIP shows payment card display but no editable CVC/CVV field. Design System promotes a bounded security code field so card enrollment can use the same Input rhythm without inventing a pattern too early.

anatomy.rule: Names the security code field and remains visible.
Uses Input rhythm, density, focus, and state model.
Signals sensitive code capture without replacing label or helper.
Lets users verify entry with an accessible field action.
Uses local length checks only for recovery.

card-security-code-input.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > valid > filled > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic field surface, error, valid, and disabled color.
Energy.behavior: Security code state is visible and contrast-safe.

Voice.decision: Use direct helper and recovery copy without implying approval.
Voice.behavior: Users know whether to correct local structure.
Voice.rejectIf: Copy says the card is approved.

Frame.decision: Reuse Input geometry, density, and full-width behavior.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System focus and loading motion only.

State.decision: Disabled and loading resolve before local validation.
State.example: Loading backend check after valid local length.
State.rejectIf: Invalid and valid are both shown.

Accessibility.decision: Use label, describedby, aria-invalid, inputmode numeric, autocomplete cc-csc, and reveal action semantics.
Accessibility.behavior: The field is operable with keyboard, paste, and assistive tech.
Accessibility.rejectIf: No label or missing invalid state.

Depth.decision: Keep card security code as a field-level surface; enrollment depth belongs to patterns.
Depth.behavior: The component does not open nested payment or ownership flows.

Tone.decision: Use direct recovery tone for local validation and avoid approval language.
Tone.behavior: The user knows whether to correct the security code.

Growth.decision: Escalate card number, expiry, tokenization, and ownership to sibling components or patterns.
Growth.behavior: Card Security Code remains one capture component.

Symbol.decision: Use the security symbol as an affordance beside visible label and helper text.
Symbol.behavior: Icon reinforces sensitive code capture without replacing text.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and alignment inside the field control.
Iconography.behavior: Security icon aligns with Input rhythm across density.

productExamples.example: Capture security code after card number and expiry.
Collect security code before enrollment submission.

guidelines.title: Use
items: Use local validation only for length.
Use reveal when users need to verify entry.

guidelines.title: Avoid
items: Do not own card number, expiry, or full card form behavior.
Do not store or echo the code outside the field.

guidelines.title: Review
items: Check card program rules before backend submission.

tests: Digit normalization on input and paste
rejectIf: The component owns backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, or submission.
The code is exposed outside the input or reveal action.
Autocomplete and numeric input mode are missing.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: large field with grouped number and close helper text
compact field paired beside expiry or date
compact field paired beside expiry or date

canUseWhen: A screen needs one CVC/CVV field.
mustAskBefore: Backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, or full card enrollment is needed.
mustNot: Do not store or expose the security code outside the field.
